mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months indicates active monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with a declining FEDFUNDS trend over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next five trading days due to earnings contraction fears.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate demand.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (year-over-year > 1.5%) signals strong corporate output momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings optimism.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in real personal consumption (RSAFS) over the prior three months indicates weakening consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS has declined over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: High monthly inflation (CPIAUCSL change > 3.0%) triggers central bank tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next five trading days through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in nonfarm employment below 155,000 thousand signals rapid labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS < 155000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and housing starts indicate severe economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through confidence erosion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both UNRATE and HOUST decline.
